shortDescription: Weapon mounts that fire an ordinary ranged weapon item from a fixed position with more range. Manned mounts use the gunner's shooting skill, aim speed and traits, and give cover. With Biotech, automated mounts run on mech subcores or an AI persona core.
body:
# Mounted Weapons (v1 built; tested once in-game, arc/centring/settings not yet tested)

## What's in the mod
A mount is a turret (`MountedWeapons.Building_WeaponMount`, subclass of Building_TurretGun) that fires a real weapon item the player installs. Quality, art, HP, biocode state and comps stay with the item.

### Manned line (always loaded)
| Def | Research | Range | Stability | Aim time | Cover (fillPercent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MW_WeaponMount | MW_WeaponMounts (Smithing) | 115% | 0.20 | 100% | 0.40 |
| MW_WeaponMountReinforced | MW_ReinforcedMounts (+Machining) | 125% | 0.35 | 90% | 0.55 |
| MW_GunEmplacement | MW_ArmoredEmplacements (+Microelectronics) | 135% | 0.50 | 80% | 0.75 |
Stability = fraction of the gunner's per-cell miss chance removed. Gunner stands one cell behind.

### Automated line (Biotech folder via LoadFolders IfModActive)
| Def | Core | Extra research | ShootingAccuracyTurret | Range | Aim | Force-target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MW_AutoMountBasic | SubcoreBasic | - | 0.95 | 120% | 100% | no |
| MW_AutoMountStandard | SubcoreRegular | StandardMechtech | 0.97 | 125% | 90% | no |
| MW_AutoMountHigh | SubcoreHigh | HighMechtech | 0.98 | 130% | 80% | yes |
| MW_AutoMountPersona | AIPersonaCore | HighMechtech | 0.987 | 135% | 70% | yes |

### Firing arc
Cone centred on the building's facing (Rot4.AsAngle). Settings: manned default 120°, automated default 360° (unlimited). Enforced in: TryFindNewTarget override (base search + InArc in validator; base IsValidTarget is private so its rules are repeated), OrderAttack (rejects with MW_TargetOutsideArc), Fire (target left arc during warmup → reset), Tick (forced target left arc → reset; TurretTop.CurRotation clamped after base tick so idle sweeps stay inside). Shown as a field-edge overlay when selected (radius = weapon range) and while placing (PlaceWorker_FiringArc, radius 12). Known: later shots in a burst aren't re-checked.

### Weapon drawing
Weapon drawn with PawnRenderUtility.DrawEquipmentAiming. With "center weapons" on (default), WeaponArtCentroid measures each weapon texture's alpha-weighted centroid once (blit to 64×64 RenderTexture, ReadPixels, cached per Texture) and offsets the draw so that centroid sits on the pivot, mirroring DrawEquipmentAiming's mesh flip and angle. Fixes off-centre art like the minigun and puts the weapon's visual mass over the rotation point.

### Weapon lifecycle
- "Choose weapon" float menu: mountable weapons on the map; ones already chosen by another mount are listed last, greyed out, "(chosen for X)".
- WorkGiver MW_InstallMountedWeapon (Hauling) → carry, 180 ticks, install. Only the weapon is reserved.
- Remove gizmo; destroyed mount drops weapon (random damage up to setting).
- Mountable = ranged primary, projectile or beam verb, not one-use, not grenade, not turret gun, not biocoded.

### Core refund
Core in costList + leavingsBlacklist. Deconstruct always returns it; killed → lost at settings chance (default 50%).

### Settings (Mod settings, Entad/Titan-style TabDrawer layout)
- General: manned arc, automated arc (Biotech only), max weapon damage on destruction, core loss chance (Biotech only), center weapon art.
- Manned mounts / Automated mounts (latter only when automated defs exist): per-mount range, misses removed (manned) or accuracy per cell (automated), aiming time.
- XML values are recorded as defaults at startup; saved entries exist only for mounts the player changed, so balance patches keep working. Apply() writes values onto MountExtension and statBases and refreshes spawned mounts (range clones rescaled; also on SpawnSetup for reinstalled minified mounts). Reset per tab removes the saved entries.
- Mockup: .circinus/mockups/settings-window.html.

## Harmony patches
- Postfix ShotReport.HitFactorFromShooter: manned mount uses gunner ShootingAccuracyPawn + stability.
- Prefix Projectile.Launch (8-arg): swap building→mounted weapon as equipment so quality and unique traits apply.

## Known limits
- No arc re-check mid-burst; mortars use non-mortar targeting; minified mount destroyed while packed loses its contents; placeholder art; CE unsupported.
